name: AlertDialog
reason: Dialog-based surfaces go through Modal's level stack; a raw AlertDialog bypasses it.

name: ComplexSelector
reason: Adds hasClear and onClear, a clear button as Selector has (facebook/astryx#6362).

name: CommandPalette
reason: The palette sits at a fixed offset from the top of the viewport instead of centred, so its input stays put while the result list shrinks or grows. The API is Astryx's.

name: Drawer
reason: A scrimless drawer stays out of the top layer (show() and a z-index), so ui-common's Modal and notification stack paint above it; a Modal inside a scrimmed drawer opens above it; aria-modal passes through. DrawerHeader is Astryx's, re-exported unchanged.

name: lab
reason: A step's highlight is promoted into the top layer once, so under StrictMode the spotlight dim no longer covers the callout.

name: lab
reason: Adds deltaTooltip, a tooltip that explains the delta, anchored to it and reachable by keyboard, with media outside it.

name: Dialog
reason: ui-common ships Modal as the one dialog surface. Hiding Dialog keeps consumers from building a second, differently behaved dialog.

name: docs.mjs
reason: Documentation data for the Astryx CLI, not runtime API. The CLI reads it from @astryxdesign/core directly.

name: groups.doc.mjs
reason: Documentation data for the Astryx CLI, not runtime API. The CLI reads it from @astryxdesign/core directly.

name: CheckboxInput
reason: Form.Item owns the label, description, required mark and status message, as in antd: ui-common's wrapper takes none of them, paints the item's status on its border, and honours the item's id, disabled and aria-*.

name: Popover
reason: Its content is not part of the Form.Item it opens from, as antd's: a control inside takes none of the item's status or label. The API is Astryx's.

name: SegmentedControl
reason: Form.Item owns the label, description, required mark and status message, as in antd: ui-common's wrapper takes none of them and honours the item's id, disabled and aria-*. It renders a fork that keeps the item's aria-describedby, with the fork's SegmentedControlItem.
